Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Scenario:
Minion A has been Mind Raped by Minion B.
During Minion B's controller's next minion phase, there is a compulsory hunt.

Question:
Can Minion B's controller take control of Minion A before the hunt?

> Name: Mind Rape
> [Sabbat:R, SW:R, KoT:R]
> Cardtype: Action
> Cost: 2 blood
> Discipline: Dominate
> Bleed with +2 bleed.
> Tap a younger vampire and put this card on that vampire; you still control this card. This vampire does not untap as normal. During your next minion phase, burn this card to untap this vampire and take control of him or her until the end of your turn.
> Artist: Scott M. Bakal; Brian LeBlanc
>
Suaku
Inceptor Asian Continental Championship

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body:
Card text implies that, at any time during my minion phase, I can take control of the Mind Raped minion.

Before I hunt, during the hunt, after the defender plays a reaction card to gain intercept, or anytime during my minion phase after the hunt.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Pagan wrote:
> Card text implies that, at any time during my minion phase, I can take control of the Mind Raped minion.
>
> Before I hunt, during the hunt, after the defender plays a reaction card to gain intercept, or anytime during my minion phase after the hunt.
>
Correct.

Messages.Author: Amenophobis
Messages.Body:
> Pagan wrote:
> Card text implies that, at any time during my minion phase, I can take control of the Mind Raped minion.
>
> Before I hunt, during the hunt, after the defender plays a reaction card to gain intercept, or anytime during my minion phase after the hunt.
>
Minion A is tapped per MR card text. When the controller of B burns the card to take control and untap A, A's first action has to be a hunt if he or she has no blood.
So the timing *when* you take control of A is not important. The fact that he or she has a mandatory action to perform doesn't change.
